card.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
card.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the spare cupboard key till tomorrow. Don't tell your flatmate I've left it here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me what's in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you accept knowing what isn't? Nothing alive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Text me when she leaves work. Just 'key', please.

mechanism: A obtains help holding a secret key by supplying minimal reassurance and accepting B's collection terms.
confusable: Unlike open delegation, A must secure participation without explaining the cupboard's full contents or purpose.
comparison: The key holder explicitly negotiates boundaries, unlike the envelope helper whose practical objection increases concealment.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
